name: Mir oxygen-candle fire
what: A solid-fuel oxygen candle in Kvant-1 burned; three extinguishers; heavy smoke through the station; the crew wore masks and goggles until the air was analysed; hardware and cable insulation near the candle destroyed.

sources.quote: After burning for fourteen minutes and using up three fire extinguishers, the fire died out.
All crew members had to wear gas-masks. This lasted two and a half hours
The heat destroyed the hardware in which the candle was burning

note: Fire duration differs between sources: early 1997 reports say about 90 seconds of open burning, later crew accounts up to 14 minutes. masksH = time in masks (2.5 h).

name: ISS Elektron overheat and KOH leak
what: Crew reported smoke and a smell from the Elektron oxygen generator (overheated seal, potassium hydroxide leak); first spacecraft emergency declared on the ISS; ventilation shut down; crew in surgical masks, goggles and gloves; the unit was repaired with parts delivered weeks later.

sources.quote: The Emergency condition lasted for approximately 2 hours.
It should take about 36 hours to completely swap and scrub the station's entire atmosphere
Russia's oxygen regeneration system on the world's sole orbital station is back online

note: No flames. The station's own atmosphere scrub took about 36 h; the Elektron itself was back online on 1 November 2006 (6 weeks).
